title: RPM update: live dock blur rendering fixed
summary: Live background blur now renders correctly beneath the animated dock, while keeping its panel-matched tint and transparent fallback.

changes.title: Available as an RPM update
changes.text: Published for ARM64 and x64 in infinityos-shell-extensions 1.0.0-10000456.fc45. Log out of the desktop and log back in after installing it to load the updated extension. Existing ISO downloads are unchanged.

changes.title: Wallpaper edges blur beneath the dock
changes.text: Fixes a case where the dock showed a tint but the wallpaper remained sharp despite an active blur effect. The dock no longer forces its entire surface into a separate rendering cache. Icon rendering and the rounded outline are preserved.

changes.title: Blur stays visible during animation
changes.text: The dock's animation and transparency updates keep the matching backdrop visible and allow it to follow the dock's size. Overview transparency preferences are preserved.

changes.title: Transparent fallback
changes.text: The dock continues to use the panel and InfinityUpdater blur settings and tint layers. If that backdrop is unavailable, the dock remains transparent. The rendering fix was confirmed in a running VM and checked with native GNOME 51 tests.

title: RPM update: dock background follows the panel
summary: The adaptive dock shares the panel and InfinityUpdater backdrop settings, with matching tint layers and a transparent fallback.

changes.title: Available as an RPM update
changes.text: Published in the Infinity OS 2.0 RPM repository for ARM64 and x64 as package release 10000446.fc45. This is not a new ISO. The latest verified ISO build, 1121f5365d587876e9c220afdbcf1702054598b9, does not include these changes.

changes.title: Shared backdrop settings
changes.text: The adaptive dock uses the same backdrop provider as the panel and InfinityUpdater. It follows the panel's live blur and brightness settings or static preset, with rounded clipping. Wallpaper sampling still follows each surface's screen position.

changes.title: Matching tint layers
changes.text: The dock paints the panel background and visible tint layers in the same order and opacity as InfinityUpdater. These replace the adaptive dock's separate neutral tint while retaining its existing outline.

changes.title: Fallback and recovery
changes.text: If the matching backdrop is unavailable, the adaptive dock remains transparent. It rebuilds the backdrop when its mode, corner radius or panel provider changes. Custom backgrounds and panel mode keep their existing styling.

title: RPM update: save RAMDrive files before restarting
summary: Available through InfinityUpdater on ARM64 and x64: choose whether to save or remove RAMDrive files before a desktop restart.

changes.title: Available as an RPM update
changes.text: Published in the Infinity OS 2.0 RPM repository for ARM64 and x64. This change is not included in the latest verified ISO build, 1121f5365d587876e9c220afdbcf1702054598b9.

changes.title: Choose before restarting
changes.text: When RAMDrive contains files, the desktop restart dialog appears in the upper-right corner with Remove & Restart and Save files. The countdown pauses while a choice is pending. Press Escape to cancel before an operation starts.

changes.title: Save files to the Desktop
changes.text: Save files moves RAMDrive contents to Saved Files on your configured Desktop, then continues the restart. Hidden files and nested folders are included. Existing saved files are kept, with numeric suffixes added to conflicting names.

changes.title: Restart only after success
changes.text: Remove & Restart clears RAMDrive before continuing. A failed operation or remaining files stops the restart and displays an error. Files already moved during a partial save remain in Saved Files; the rest stay in RAMDrive. GNOME's update and session checks are preserved.

title: RPM updates: desktop polish and update recovery
summary: Available through InfinityUpdater on ARM64 and x64: a tapping glove cursor, updater and dock fixes, clearer dependency handling, and more reliable authorization and downloads.

changes.title: Available as RPM updates
changes.text: These changes are published in the Infinity OS 2.0 RPM repository for ARM64 and x64. They are not a new ISO release. The latest verified ISO build remains 1121f5365d587876e9c220afdbcf1702054598b9 and does not include the changes below.

changes.title: Tapping glove cursor
changes.text: The busy cursor now shows a stationary glove tapping its fingers instead of a spinning beachball. Tapping starts immediately, with a fixed palm and pointer position across supported cursor sizes.

changes.title: Updater appearance and motion
changes.text: Removed dark rectangular shadows and hover artifacts over the blurred background. The header now matches the backdrop, with a System update title and a compact refresh button. The window slides into place without an opening bounce and respects reduced-motion settings.

changes.title: Dock blur
changes.text: Restored blur behind the visible dock, with its size and rounded corners following the dock background.

changes.title: Packages waiting for compatibility
changes.text: RPM updates blocked by incompatible dependencies appear in a separate expandable group. They are excluded from the ready-to-install count and installation actions, then offered automatically when compatible dependencies become available.

changes.title: Tray and top bar
changes.text: Centered tray icons inside their cells and removed empty space left by hidden indicators. The top bar hides the power-profile icon and connected Ethernet icon, while keeping Wi-Fi and disconnected-network status visible.

changes.title: Open InfinityTerminal from applications
changes.text: Opening InfinityTerminal from the application list now uses its pull-down drawer. It waits for the overview to close and focuses the existing terminal when it is already visible.

changes.title: Update authorization
changes.text: The updater stays visible while the administrator password dialog is open and shows an Authorizing phase. Authorization failures and unexpected helper errors are reported instead of leaving the interface busy indefinitely.

changes.title: Download recovery
changes.text: If an offline repository download fails, the updater refreshes repository metadata and retries once. Downloaded packages and the existing offline transaction are preserved. Local RPM installs and the restart step are not retried.

title: Terminal handle, dock and updater
summary: Glove cursors and smoother terminal dragging, consistent dock corners, updater blur, and tray and update-list fixes.

changes.title: Terminal handle
changes.text: The handle uses the top bar's actual blur and reconnects when the panel background reloads. An open glove appears on hover and closes while dragging.

changes.title: Drag without bounce
changes.text: Pulling the terminal by hand follows the pointer and settles without bounce. Clicking the handle or pressing Super+T keeps the bounce animation.

changes.title: Dock corners
changes.text: The lower corners use the same outline color as the sides. The thicker top edge is unchanged.

changes.title: InfinityUpdater background
changes.text: The ISO window uses the top bar's blur with slightly darker header and button areas. A later RPM update fixed the solid background remaining after a delayed blur setup; that fix is not included in this ISO. With the update installed, transparency follows the backdrop's readiness and recovers when it is rebuilt. Text and controls stay sharp.

changes.title: Tray layout
changes.text: App tray icons sit in Quick Settings below the system controls and volume sliders. Large icons fit their cells, spacing is consistent, and small groups are centered. The three-dot button was removed.

changes.title: Tray controls
changes.text: Right-click an icon to pin it to the top bar, return it to Quick Settings, or hide it. These choices are saved, and hidden apps can be restored from the tray's context menu. Menus stay open during refreshes and icon order survives extension reloads.

changes.title: Update indicator
changes.text: InfinityUpdater stays separate from the app tray. Its badge shows the number of available updates.

changes.title: Cancelled installation
changes.text: Cancelling the password prompt keeps available updates on screen. A failed installation reports the error instead of clearing the list.

changes.title: GNOME 51 fixes
changes.text: Fixed an error when drawing rounded workspace previews and removed obsolete arguments from terminal window resizing.

title: Clock, terminal handle and lock screen
summary: Fixed clock alignment, compact-handle detection and lock-screen spacing.

changes.title: Clock
changes.text: The clock stays centered when the time changes or InfinityTerminal opens. Its position is aligned to whole pixels to avoid blurred text.

changes.title: Terminal handle
changes.text: Maximized windows now shrink the handle even when the theme leaves a small gap below the top bar.

changes.title: Lock screen
changes.text: The avatar and password field are centered together, with enough space below the large clock.

changes.title: Dock
changes.text: The adaptive dock has a stronger top edge. Custom border colors are preserved.

title: ARM64 and x64 images with the terminal handle
summary: Both images include the pull-down terminal handle, smaller terminal sizes and dock overlap fixes for live sessions.

changes.title: Open the terminal
changes.text: Click the handle below the clock or drag it down. Release to keep the chosen height. A short drag closes it; Escape cancels the gesture.

changes.title: Handle size
changes.text: The handle shrinks when the terminal is open or a window reaches the top bar. Overview and the lock screen hide it.

changes.title: Terminal height
changes.text: The terminal can be resized below half the screen, down to 96 pixels. Drag its lower edge up to the top bar to hide it.

changes.title: Live-session dock
changes.text: Window overlap detection now works in the live desktop and ignores minimized windows.

changes.title: Downloads
changes.text: ARM64 and x64 images were published to R2. Older files are kept for six minutes after the download links change so cached pages can catch up.

title: Terminal pull handle
summary: InfinityTerminal can now be opened and resized by dragging from the top bar.

changes.title: Click or drag
changes.text: The handle below the clock opens the terminal with a click or downward drag. Releasing it keeps the selected height.

changes.title: Hide the terminal
changes.text: Drag the lower edge back to the top bar, make a short pull, or use the existing keyboard shortcut.

changes.title: Desktop behavior
changes.text: The handle shrinks near windows and stays centered independently of the clock layout. It follows the selected theme and reduced-motion setting.

changes.title: Dock
changes.text: The dock moves out of the way when a window reaches its area, including in the live session.

title: ARM64 and x64 images, NVIDIA and Steam fixes
summary: New Fedora 45 images, direct downloads and fixes for installation, Steam and the desktop tools.

changes.title: Downloads
changes.text: ARM64 and x64 ISOs are available directly from R2. The website reads filenames, sizes and MD5/SHA-256 checksums from the release manifest.

changes.title: NVIDIA installation
changes.text: On supported x64 hardware, installation builds and checks the driver modules before finishing. Driver failures stop installation rather than appearing at first boot. This step needs an internet connection.

changes.title: Steam and TV Mode
changes.text: Both use the working Steam runtime launcher. TV-session startup and exit were corrected. Steam stays closed after setup so its first update can finish from the desktop.

changes.title: InfinitySetup and InfinityConfig
changes.text: Setup opens on the System tab and searches across categories. Config's unused search bar was removed. Both apps have their own icons, and grouped setup changes need one administrator authorization.

changes.title: InfinityTerminal
changes.text: Added configurable system readings, timers, Pomodoro, network transfer, battery, weather and a second time zone. The widget row can be reordered. The terminal now starts its opening animation fully above the screen.

changes.title: InfinityUpdater
changes.text: Adjusted the opening animation and button contrast in both themes. Offline updates now show a restart notification. Restart handling and completion messages were fixed.

changes.title: Desktop
changes.text: Adjusted desktop and dock icon sizes and mounted-drive artwork. NowPlay and Raccoon Launcher are included.

changes.title: Live installer
changes.text: Firefox opens the changelog instead of the Fedora start page.
